avalinexus.companion.name: %s (%s's companion)
avalinexus.dialogue.hint: Scroll or 1-%s, E to pick, hold Alt for the mouse
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.1: Oh, a visitor! Don't mind the cold, you get used to it.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.2: Hello, traveler. You look a little lost out here.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.3: A new face! The pack will want to hear about you.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.night: Up this late? The stars are brighter when it's this cold.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.rain: Ugh, this rain gets into every feather...
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.1: We never stay in one place for long. When the pack moves, we all move.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.2: Your kind builds walls to keep the cold out. We just grow more feathers.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.3: Every pack has its own song. You'd hear ours at night if you listened.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.4: Our tech keeps us alive out here. Batteries, heaters, a few secrets too!
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.5: Sometimes a pack gets split up by a storm. We always look for the missing ones.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.night: Most of the pack is asleep. I keep watch, someone has to.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.trade.soon: Take a look, I might have what you need.
avalinexus.reputation.title: %s · %s
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.wary.1: My pack remembers what you did.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.wary.2: I have nothing to say to you.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.recruit.1: Alright, I'm with you. Lead the way!
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.recruit.2: My pack will understand. Let's go!
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.role.1: Fine, I'll take care of that.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.dismiss.1: It was an honour. My pack is waiting for me.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.farewell.1: Safe travels! Watch out for the ice.
avalinexus.shop.title: Avali Shop
avalinexus.shop.missing_items: You don't have enough of this item
avalinexus.breeding.born: A baby was born in the %s
avalinexus.breeding.selected: %s is ready to bond, use the feather on a partner
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.partn: Have you seen %s? We never stray far from each other.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.partner.1: %s and I share everything, even the coldest nights.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.partner.2: If you see %s, tell them I'm thinking of them.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.4: Welcome to our frozen lands. Stay close to the heaters if you get cold.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.5: Well, a featherless one! It's been a while since we saw one around here.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.6: Hey! Good timing, I was starting to get bored.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.7: Did the wind carry you to us? Be welcome.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.8: Easy, your big feet are scaring the fish away.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.9: Oh! You startled me. I didn't hear you coming.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.10: Hello, traveler. What brings you so far into the cold?
Don't come too close. I'm watching you.
The pack talks about you, and not kindly.
If you're here to cause trouble, leave now.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.frien: Ah, it's you! The pack speaks well of you, you know.
Good to see you again, featherless friend!
You're back! Did you bring fish this time?
Hey, I was just thinking about you!
Packmate! Come warm up with us.
There's always a spot by the heater for you.
You almost smell like an Avali now. That's a compliment!
The pack sings your name in the evening, you know?
Whoa! You're so big and you don't have feathers!
Hi! Do you want to play with me?
The grown-ups say I shouldn't talk to strangers... but you look nice!
Are you cold? Not me, I've got lots of fluff!
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.night: Shh, the pack is sleeping. Keep your voice down.
Rain, here? I'd rather have snow.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.greeting.partn: %s is never far. We always meet up by the heater.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.6: Graphene is the base of everything we build. Light, strong, and it never rusts.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.7: Nexite crystals hum when you get close. At least, that's what the elders say.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.8: We weave our tapestries in the pack's colours. That way, everyone knows where we come from.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.9: Ammonia is like water to us. For you, though, better not drink it.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.10: When it's too warm, I feel like I'm melting. How do you stand it?
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.11: A lone Avali is a sad Avali. We always live and sleep as a pack.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.12: Have you ever watched an aurora from the ice? Nothing beats it.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.wary.3: You think we forget that quickly?
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.wary.4: The others told me to be careful around you.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.wary.5: Prove you're better than that, and we'll see.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.wary.6: I'll talk, but I'm keeping an eye on you.
You know, few featherless ones take the time to talk to us. Thank you.
If you find nexite crystals, keep them safe. They're worth a lot to us.
Stay a while, the heater's on.
Next time, I'll show you my favorite fishing spot.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.ally.1: You're part of the pack now. That means we look out for you.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.ally.2: If you ever need help, just ask. I'll come.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.ally.3: I saved a feather for you. Well, I lost it... but it's the thought that counts!
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.ally.4: You sing off-key, but we love you anyway.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.baby.1: When I grow up, I'll have the prettiest feathers in the pack!
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.baby.2: Did you know you can eat snow? Well, it doesn't taste like anything.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.baby.3: I caught a fish all by myself! Well, almost.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.baby.4: The grown-ups never let me touch the machines...
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.baby.5: I don't bite! Except my tail, sometimes.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.baby.6: What's your pack name? You don't have a pack?! That's sad...
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.night.2: At night, you can hear the ice creaking. It lulls me to sleep.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.talk.partner.3: %s and I are planning to weave a big tapestry together.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.farewell.3: May the wind be gentle with you.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.farewell.4: Come back whenever you like, the pack will be here.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.farewell.5: Go, and don't get lost in the storm.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.farewell.6: See you next time! Bring some fish.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.farewell.10: I'll tell the pack you stopped by.
And don't come back too soon.
I've got my eye on you.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.farewell.frien: It was a pleasure. Take care of yourself.
I'll save you a spot by the heater.
The pack watches over you, wherever you go.
If you run into danger, shout. We'll hear you.
Bye bye! Come back and play!
I'm going to tell the grown-ups I have a new friend!
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.trade.1: Look at what I've got. All handmade, mostly.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.trade.2: A bit of nexite and it's yours.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.trade.5: No haggling, okay? Well... maybe a little.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.trade.friendly: For you, I put aside my best pieces.
Friends of the pack pay a little less, enjoy it.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.trade.ally.1: Take what you need, packmate. I'll give you a good price.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.trade.ally.2: For a packmate, my prices melt like snow in the sun.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.recruit.4: I'll follow you, but you share your fish.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.recruit.5: Together, we'll be a little pack of two.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.role.3: A new role? I like it.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.role.5: You can count on me for that.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.dismiss.3: Thanks for the journey. I won't forget.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.dismiss.4: If you need me again, you know where to find me.
avalinexus.dialogue.avali.dismiss.5: The pack is going to hear so many stories!

avalinexus.archive.title: Avali Archives
avalinexus.archive.avali.title: The Avali
avalinexus.archive.avali.text: The Avali are a small, feathered and nomadic people who live in packs. They thrive in the cold and travel light, carrying their technology from one camp to the next.
avalinexus.archive.nexite.title: Nexite
avalinexus.archive.nexite.text: Nexite is a yellow crystal found deep underground, and closer to the surface in the polar taiga. The Avali use it as currency and at the heart of their technology.
avalinexus.archive.polar_taiga.title: The Polar Taiga
avalinexus.archive.polar_taiga.text: A frozen forest swept by blizzards. Without warm clothes, a shelter or a heater, travellers slowly freeze. It is the home of the Avali.
avalinexus.settings.title: Avali Nexus Options
avalinexus.archive.fluids.title: Avali Fluids
avalinexus.archive.fluids.text: Three fluids power Avali technology. Liquid ammonia fills lakes in the polar taiga, on the surface and underground. The refinery turns it into coolant, which runs the freezer, and into Avali fuel, which runs the refinery, the press, the weapon workbench and the heater. They all travel in buckets, pipes and tanks.
avalinexus.archive.pipes_tanks.title: Pipes and Tanks
avalinexus.archive.pipes_tanks.text: Connected graphene pipes form a network that carries one fluid at a time, about two buckets per second. An open pipe never spills. Right click a pipe to turn its arm toward a machine or a tank. A graphene tank holds sixteen buckets per block, and neighboring tanks merge up to a 3 × 3 base and 8 blocks high. Right click with an empty hand to see what it holds. Broken, it keeps its fluid.
avalinexus.archive.pump_tap.title: Pump and Tap
avalinexus.archive.pump_tap.text: The fluid pump sits on top of an ammonia or water lake and pumps endlessly, with no fuel. It sends the fluid out of its back, sides and top. The tap fills an empty bucket from the pipe or tank behind it.
avalinexus.archive.machines.title: Machines
avalinexus.archive.machines.text: Every machine has fixed faces: the front holds the screen, the back takes what runs it, the sides take the fluid to transform and the top gives back the fluid it makes. Items go in from the top with a hopper and come out from the bottom, like a furnace. In the screen, a full bucket under a gauge fills the machine, and an empty bucket drains it.
avalinexus.archive.refinery.title: Ammonia Refinery
avalinexus.archive.refinery.text: The refinery takes ammonia from its sides and gives its product from the top. A bucket of ammonia and a graphene make a bucket of coolant, a bucket of ammonia and a coal make two buckets of fuel. It heats with fuel piped into its back, or with coal for its first start. Pipe its fuel output into its own back and it feeds itself.
avalinexus.archive.freezer.title: Cryo Freezer
avalinexus.archive.freezer.text: The freezer runs on coolant piped into its back. Water or ammonia come in from its sides and become ice or ammonia ice. It also packs ice into packed ice then blue ice, and ammonia ice into packed ammonia ice. An empty bucket with water makes a bucket of powder snow.
avalinexus.archive.press.title: Graphene Press
avalinexus.archive.press.text: The press runs on fuel piped into its back. Four coal and a Nexite shard make six graphene there, instead of four at the crafting table.
avalinexus.archive.workbench.title: Weapon Workbench
avalinexus.archive.workbench.text: The workbench makes rail weapons, their magazines, Nexite quills and aerotech weapons. Pick the item in the list, put the ingredients in the grid, and it is made with fuel piped into its back. Most items cost one graphene less than at the crafting table, and quills come out by twenty four instead of sixteen. The sniper and the singing blade are made there without a smithing table.
avalinexus.archive.avalon.title: Avalon
avalinexus.archive.avalon.text: Avalon is the Avali homeworld, an icy moon orbiting a gas giant far from its star. It hovers between -40 and -50°C, its gravity is about a quarter of Earth's and its thick air is made of methane and nitrogen. Its oceans are liquid ammonia, and its ice shelves drift and crack endlessly. Tidal heat melts water under the ice, which bursts out of cryovolcanoes: to the Avali, liquid water is as dangerous as lava, and the snow it leaves feeds fierce blizzards.
avalinexus.archive.biology.title: Biology
avalinexus.archive.biology.text: The Avali look a bit like a cross between a large rabbit and a small raptor. An adult stands about one meter tall, with a long tail for balance, feathered wings with small clawed fingers and four long ears. Their bodies run on liquid ammonia instead of water, which makes them perfect for the cold but finds Earth-like worlds unbearably hot. Their blood is pale violet. Females wear muted, speckled feathers while males show bright iridescent bands.
avalinexus.archive.senses.title: Senses
avalinexus.archive.senses.text: Their big eyes only help in the dim light of Avalon: their true sense is hearing. Their four ears move on their own and can follow several sounds at once, so well that an Avali can "see" a creature hidden behind a wall. Packmates even talk in parallel, each one handling a part of the conversation.
avalinexus.archive.packs.title: Packs
avalinexus.archive.packs.text: An Avali is rarely alone. Packs of three to six individuals grow up together from a young age and share bonds closer than family, even if they are rarely related. Each pack builds its own habits and cues and specializes in a trade. Losing a packmate is a terrible blow, and replacing one is almost impossible.
avalinexus.archive.tribes.title: Tribes and colonies
avalinexus.archive.tribes.text: Packs with complementary skills gather into tribes to reach a shared goal, like mining a rich asteroid. A tribe owns what it produces beyond its work order. When several tribes settle close to each other, a colony grows around them, run by a council of packs.
avalinexus.archive.nomads.title: Nomads
avalinexus.archive.nomads.text: The Avali are nomads at heart: keep it simple, drop what you can afford to lose, look after what you cannot. Portable stoves replace campfires and holographic screens replace the embroidered tapestries of old tents. Their tents are woven from carbon nanofibre strong enough to stop bullets. To them the frozen tundra is a desert, and their tents shelter them from the snow blown across the ice.
avalinexus.archive.arts.title: Arts
avalinexus.archive.arts.text: With hearing as their main sense, the Avali love music more than anything: most can sing or play an instrument, and many packs play as a band. They still enjoy bold, high contrast patterns on their tents and clothes, and each pack has its own colors. They also wear crystal and metal chimes, the sound version of bright colors.
avalinexus.archive.the_nexus.title: The Nexus
avalinexus.archive.the_nexus.text: The Nexus is a vast interstellar network, a virtual world running alongside the real one. Nearly every Avali reaches it through a neural implant, in augmented reality or full virtual reality. It displays information on anything, projects plans and instructions over the world and lets packs meet and talk across whole star systems.
avalinexus.archive.illuminate.title: The Illuminate
avalinexus.archive.illuminate.text: The Illuminate is the largest Avali faction, gathering nearly half of the species and ruling Avalon. It is a scientific meritocracy helped by a restrained artificial intelligence, the Oracle, which plans growth and shares out resources. It guards the Nexus and its knowledge jealously.
avalinexus.archive.independents.title: Independent worlds
avalinexus.archive.independents.text: Beyond Illuminate space live as many Avali again, in colonies that refused its rule or were founded out of its reach. These worlds are very diverse, often live beside other species and share a strong frontier spirit. Without the Nexus they rely on their own ingenuity.
avalinexus.archive.augmentation.title: Augmentation
avalinexus.archive.augmentation.text: Almost every Avali carries implants: at the very least a neural interface to reach the Nexus and medical nanites watching over their health. Some go much further, with life support implants for harsh worlds, replacement limbs or even a whole cybernetic body.
avalinexus.archive.aerotech.title: Aerotech blades
avalinexus.archive.aerotech.text: Avali blades are small printers: the hilt forges a light, aerogel-like crystal that slides out as a razor-sharp edge. When worn out, the blade snaps off in sections and grows back. Ranged weapons use rails to fire tiny metal darts at great speed.
avalinexus.archive.drones.title: Drones
avalinexus.archive.drones.text: Drones are everywhere in Avali life, from tiny helpers a few centimeters wide to whole combat vessels. Many run on their own with a simple AI, others are flown through a neural link. They build, carry, heal and protect.
avalinexus.archive.meeting_avali.title: Meeting the Avali
avalinexus.archive.meeting_avali.text: Avali live in the polar taiga. Right click one to talk: you can chat, trade or leave. Each Avali has its own shop, paid in Nexite, which restocks every day. They rest, sleep in beds, sit on cushions and panic when attacked.
avalinexus.archive.graphene.title: Graphene
avalinexus.archive.graphene.text: Graphene is made from coal or charcoal and a Nexite shard, and it is at the heart of Avali building. It becomes graphene blocks for sturdy walls, nanocanvas for tents, nanofibre for beams, and heaters. The graphene press makes six from the same recipe.
avalinexus.archive.aerogel.title: Aerogel
avalinexus.archive.aerogel.text: Aerogel is a light, see-through material made from glass and a Nexite shard. It comes as blocks, panes, slabs, stairs and walls, and it can be picked back up without Silk Touch.
avalinexus.archive.camps.title: Nomad camps
avalinexus.archive.camps.text: Nanocanvas is wool reinforced with graphene. It comes in every dye color, resists creepers and never burns. Nanofibre blocks and walls make the beams and poles, together they build proper Avali tents.
avalinexus.archive.heater.title: The cold
avalinexus.archive.heater.text: Out in the polar taiga you slowly freeze. Leather armor or a roof over your head keeps you warm, and a heater burning furnace fuel protects everyone within ten blocks. It only burns fuel when someone is around. A pipe of Avali fuel plugged into its back also feeds it, and it burns that fuel first.
avalinexus.archive.decorations.title: Decorations
avalinexus.archive.decorations.text: Tapestries hang on walls, floors or ceilings and let you build right in front of them. Right click with an empty hand to turn them. You can also find Avali beds, cushions, carpets, lamps and crystal pots.

avalinexus.archive.aerotech_blades.title: Aerotech Blades
avalinexus.archive.aerotech_blades.text: An aerotech hilt prints a blade of hard crystal, close to aerogel. Every hit wears it down a little, and once it is spent it shatters and leaves only the hilt. Right click with aerogel in your inventory to reforge it at once, or keep the hilt on you: it reforges by itself in five minutes. There are four blades: the dagger, quick, the blade, balanced, the longblade, slow but with a longer reach, and the singing blade, forged at the smithing table from an aerotech blade and a Nexite ingot. The aerotech axe works the same way: heavy and slow, it chops wood and knocks shields aside. The aerotech spear strikes from further away and can be charged, running, to skewer what stands in front. They can all be made for less at the weapon workbench.
avalinexus.archive.rail_weapons.title: Rail Weapons
avalinexus.archive.rail_weapons.text: Rail weapons launch Nexite quills with a magnetic field. Left click to fire, hold right click to aim, R to reload. The pistol and the assault rifle fire in bursts, the carbine is precise, the shotgun spreads eight quills at close range, and the sniper, forged from a carbine, hits very hard at long range. They can all be made for less at the weapon workbench.
avalinexus.archive.quills_magazines.text: Nexite quills are the ammo of rail weapons: one Nexite nugget and one graphene make sixteen. Each weapon uses its own magazine. Right click with a magazine in hand to fill it with quills, then press R to insert it: the weapon takes the fullest magazine and the old one goes back to your bag. Hold R to take the magazine out. The shotgun has no magazine, it loads quills one by one. The weapon workbench makes twenty four.
